messages:
maria: Heads-up — we plan to enable Tenant Isolation for Private/VPC customers starting 2026-06-01 09:00 PT. This adds per-tenant network isolation, scoped KMS keys, and default audit logging. Docs and rollout notes below.

devon: Is this opt-in or enforced immediately? Any customer-facing downtime? :thinking:

maria: Rollout is phased: Week 1 opt-in beta for customers with active PS engagements; Week 2 opt-in for new Private signups; Week 4 auto-enforce for customers who opted into >=2 security controls. No planned customer-visible downtime. Customers will get 7 days notice before auto-enforcement.

sara: For PS: what do we send customers? migration steps, example config?

maria: Short migration snippet to include in onboarding guide: 

```
# private-config.yaml
tenant_isolation:
  enabled: true
  kms_scope: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd-1234
  network_policy: strict
```

Link: https://intranet.redwood/internal/private/tenant-isolation

ben-ps: I will draft a one-pager + 15-min webinar for customers. ETA EOD Wed.

sam-security: Security note: audit logs and bucket isolation will be ON by default for isolated tenants. Customers without KMS or with legacy SSO will be blocked from auto-enforcement. We need a clear pre-check and console blocker message.

maria: Agreed — PS will run pre-checks; console will surface blockers. We'll block auto-enforce for accounts missing required integrations.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: tenant-isolation-feature -> canary -> 2026-05-30T02:00:00Z. Rollback window: 2 hours. Monitor p95 latency and error-rate alerts.

devon: Expected perf impact? p95 token latency?

maria: Estimated <5% p95 change. If p95 >10% or error rate spikes, we pause canary and revert. Dedicated dashboard available: /dashboards/tenant-isolation.

sara: PS will run pre-checks against the active rollout list and open tickets for blockers.

ben-ps: +1. I'll coordinate webinar invites and the one-pager for CSMs.

maria: Thanks — please review the doc and add comments. I'll post a public customer announcement once canary is stable. :rocket:
